serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
It’s finally over… I just hung up on her. I don’t like lying to my mom, but I have no choice… Telling her truth would break her heart. It’s all just a temporary thing anyway. I just need to wait until a more economically liberal president is elected. After that everything is gonna be ok again.
She just needs to chill out now and give me some time…
You: Whatever… Let’s just drink coffee and chill.
*ping*
It happened again! Coffee is ready and I didn’t touch a thing!
Maybe it’s voice activated now? Some software update…{{wi}} Probably not. They went out of business after all…
I'm getting spooked… {{wi}}What’s going on?
